description: OpenAI's most capable embedding model. Produces 3072-dimensional embeddings for text, optimized for both English and multilingual use cases. Offers excellent performance on retrieval, clustering, and classification tasks.

architecture.note: Dimensions can be reduced (e.g., to 256, 512, 1024) with minimal performance loss

trainingData.description: Trained on a large corpus of text data. Specific training data composition is proprietary.

trainingProcedure: Trained using contrastive learning techniques. Specific methodology is proprietary.

evaluation.performanceSummary: State-of-the-art performance on MTEB benchmark. Significantly outperforms text-embedding-ada-002 on retrieval and classification tasks.

knownLimitations: May not capture domain-specific nuances without fine-tuning
Higher cost than smaller embedding models

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: Embeddings may encode biases present in training data. Consider evaluation for specific use cases.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Input content filtering applied by OpenAI's usage policies.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Text sent to the API may be processed by OpenAI. Consider data sensitivity.
